title: Correlation Ambiguity, Diversification Fragility, and Insurance Pricing
abstract: arXiv:2603.18969v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study how correlation ambiguity affects insurance supply, investment, and pricing in a competitive market. An insurer jointly chooses underwriting and risky investment under worst-case correlation uncertainty, with the insurance loading determined by insurance supply and household demand. With the correlation midpoint and all other model parameters fixed, widening the correlation interval makes diversification less reliable. With underwriting fixed, absolute financial investment weakly declines; with endogenous underwriting, investment may instead rise as insurance supply contracts. Nevertheless, joint exposure to uncertain dependence, measured by underwriting times absolute financial investment, strictly decreases whenever positive. Once this exposure vanishes, further ambiguity leaves the equilibrium unchanged. Insurance prices redistribute ambiguity costs between insurer and policyholder, while combined local certainty-equivale

translated_title: 相关性模糊性、分散化脆弱性与保险定价
translated_abstract: 我们研究相关性模糊性如何影响竞争市场中的保险供给、投资与定价。保险公司在最坏情形相关性不确定性下，联合选择承保规模与风险投资，保险附加费由保险供给与家庭需求共同决定。在相关性中点及其他所有模型参数固定的情况下，扩大相关性区间会降低分散化的可靠性。当承保规模固定时，绝对金融投资弱递减；当承保规模内生决定时，随着保险供给收缩，投资反而可能上升。然而，以承保规模乘以绝对金融投资所衡量的对不确定依赖关系的联合风险敞口，只要为正就会严格递减。一旦该敞口降为零，进一步的模糊性将不再改变均衡。保险价格在保险公司与投保人之间重新分配模糊性成本，而综合的局部确定性等价（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文研究相关性模糊性对竞争性保险市场的影响，发现扩大相关性不确定区间会削弱分散化的可靠性，使保险公司对不确定依赖关系的联合风险敞口严格收缩，而保险价格则成为在保险公司与投保人之间重新分配模糊性成本的机制。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that widening correlation ambiguity erodes the reliability of diversification and strictly shrinks the insurer's joint exposure to uncertain dependence, while insurance prices serve to redistribute ambiguity costs between insurers and policyholders.
